fusions.name: Ride Down the Gangway
fusions.desc: Charges down a cone 3 tiles long ahead of you that deals 13 damage to everything in it and knocks each enemy back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Kick and Carry On
fusions.desc: A shod kick that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds; you move 15% faster for 3 seconds after. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Tireless Crossing
fusions.desc: Your stamina recovery rises by 50% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: League After League
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently 10% higher.
